messages.subject: gpagen error in reading curve matrix
parts:
I’m cranking out some code in geomorph but got stuck on an odd error defining semilandmarks (see code below).

The problem goes away if I set curves to NULL so I’m assuming it has something to do with the matrix I’m using. I checked for missing values and whether the matrix is too big -- but no na’s and it’s the right number of semi landmarks (see code below).

I also tried it with a dummy table I generated just in R and that caused the same problem - could I have a mistake with the landmark before/after bounds? Would having a before/after landmark too far away from the slider cause an error like this?

Thanks so much,
Ariel

Ariel,

 

The files worked fine for me, though it took some experimentation to discern whether your rows or  columns were the objects (you never specified).

 

Below is code that worked on my machine. I suggest you install a fresh copy of geomorph and proceed from there.

 

Dean

 

######

library(geomorph)

sliders<-read.csv("smatrix.csv",header=T)

 

#Matrix is 867 x 51.  YOu didn't specify whether rows or columns were the objects!

mydat<-read.csv("17_11_09_SkullptsforGeomorphGrp.csv",header=T,row.names=1)

 

land<-arrayspecs(t(mydat),p=289,k=3)  #columns are objects: confirmed via experimentation

res1<-gpagen(land)

plot(res1)

 

res2<-gpagen(land,curves = sliders)

plot(res2)

#####
